Constraint: 520 KB total SRAM (320 KB usable DRAM)
Status: Engineering Estimate: Statistically fits in DRAM, but on-chip recurrent layer execution is compute and battery intensive without hardware vector acceleration.
Verified Architecture: Wristband samples IMU and streams via BLE; companion smartphone executes TFLite inference in real time.
Verified Anti-Aliasing: Analog/digital bandwidth (21 Hz) is strictly below 50 Hz Nyquist limit.
Infeasible on-sensor: Sensor analog filter cannot cut off below 21 Hz, creating aliasing between 8-21 Hz. Requires 100 Hz acquisition with digital anti-aliasing filter before decimation.
